question: In which state was the Sling Dong Fairrieanum Orchid Conservation Reserve notified for the conservation of the orchid Paphiopedilum fairrieanum in the year 2008?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Due to the **endemic nature **of the **Ladies Slipper Faireanum Orchid **in South **Sikkim's Tinkitam **forest, as well as the growing necessity for its **protection**, **preservation**, and **propagation**, the State Government commissioned and established **Sling-Dong.**
 
• In **2008**, the **Faireanum Conservation Reserve **had a surface area of** 6 Ha.**
 
• At adding the Wildlife Reserve, the coverage of the network of wildlife protected areas expanded to **30.77%** of the States' total **geographic area **by the end of 2008, which is once more remarkably the highest coverage among other States in the nation. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**
